scene: Holding the humming spark wrench, you face three waiting transports along the platform.
picture: Side view along the windy turbine racetrack deck. On the far left, a moored brass airship rests with lowered gangway. In the centre, the girl in teal hoodie holds a blue spark wrench in her purple wheelchair. On the right idles an orange delivery truck. On the far right stands a lit glass elevator.

a boxy orange delivery truck parked idling on the right
